title: Fixed benefit health insurance
summary: Explains how fixed benefit (fixed indemnity) health insurance pays preset cash benefits for hospital and doctor services and what to know before buying.

assets.alt: Learn more about fixed benefit health insurance

atoms.title: What fixed benefit health insurance is
atoms.question: What is fixed benefit health insurance?
atoms.text: Fixed benefit health insurance, sometimes referred to as hospital and doctor fixed indemnity insurance, pays a preset amount to the policyholder or the provider for specific covered medical services. It is also sometimes called indemnity insurance or fee for service insurance. The benefit stays the same no matter what the total bill was and no matter what other insurance pays.

atoms.title: Why buy fixed benefit health insurance
atoms.question: Why would I buy fixed benefit health insurance?
atoms.text: UnitedHealthcare says unexpected medical bills can disrupt even the most stable household budgets. Fixed benefit health insurance can help ensure extra medical costs do not come with extra worries. The plans are designed to give traditional health insurance a boost by paying a preset payment when a person receives a qualified medical service specified in the plan.

How does fixed benefit insurance help with medical bills?

atoms.title: How fixed benefit plans pay benefits
atoms.question: How do I use a fixed benefit health plan?
atoms.text: To use benefits: the policyholder or provider submits a covered expense, and the fixed benefit for that service is paid no matter what other insurance coverage the person has. No deductible has to be met before benefits are received. The plan lets members choose their doctor or health facility.

atoms.title: Provider choice and year-round enrollment
atoms.question: Can I choose any doctor and apply any time with fixed benefit insurance?
atoms.text: With a fixed benefit plan, a person can go to any doctor or health care facility they want. They may save money with discounted rates for services if they use providers in the plan's network, which varies by state. Applications can be made year-round, not just during an enrollment period or because of special circumstances.

atoms.title: Is fixed benefit insurance an ACA plan
atoms.question: Is fixed benefit health insurance an Affordable Care Act (ACA) plan?
atoms.text: UnitedHealthcare states that fixed benefit health insurance provides limited benefits and is a supplement to health insurance, not a substitute for the minimum essential coverage required by the ACA. Lack of major medical coverage may result in an additional payment with taxes. This fixed indemnity product provides benefits in a stated amount regardless of the actual expenses incurred.

atoms.title: Network note for people with major medical plans
atoms.question: Should I consider my medical plan's network when using a fixed benefit plan?
atoms.text: A footnote on UnitedHealthcare's page says that people with a major medical plan may need to stay with certain networks and providers to get the most coverage out of that plan. They should take that into consideration when choosing where they get care, even though a fixed benefit plan lets them go to any doctor or facility.

atoms.title: Fixed benefit plan details to check in the brochure
atoms.question: What limits apply to fixed benefit plan benefits?
atoms.text: UnitedHealthcare notes that some benefits increase the longer a person has the plan. Some plans may have waiting periods for wellness or preventive services. Intensive care or critical care hospitalization benefits are subject to a maximum number of days per confinement, and if more than one surgery occurs in a day, the highest tiered amount is paid. A drug discount card, where included, is for prescription discounts only and is not insurance.

atoms.title: Fixed benefit plan contact and shopping options
atoms.question: How do I shop for fixed benefit health insurance?
atoms.text: UnitedHealthcare lets shoppers view fixed benefit health insurance plans by state using a ZIP code. Shoppers can also call 1-877-914-3210 with questions. The page also offers a video, titled as a way to learn more about fixed benefit health insurance, and links to other supplemental plans such as dental, vision and cash-benefit plans.
